INSULATED FERRULES

Small electrical parts. Strong hierarchy.

VISUAL IDEA

Design,
assembled in volume.

The tall pouch uses a violet upper panel for the brand and name. Ferrule images show the product shape, while a white area keeps the content easy to read.

Contrasting panels collect conductor size, voltage, protection rating and length into one information column. A coloured lower block completes the composition and highlights quantity.
